channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran steps up Hormuz surveillance: Attacks soar, oil flows crash again
item.description: Ships in the Strait of Hormuz have been experiencing the worst spate of attacks since the start of the war.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills Palestinian woman in Gaza City
item.description: The woman's young daughter was rescued from a large fire inside the apartment, caused by the attack.

item.title: How do Iranians move money abroad to avoid US sanctions?
item.description: From currency brokers to crypto, Iranians find ways to circumvent sanctions, but each comes with its own problems.

item.title: ‘Massive’ Russian attack on Ukraine kills at least six, damages power sites
item.description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine's partners failed to warn of Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.

item.title: Photos: Student protest in Albania prompts violent clashes with police
item.description: Protesters in Tirana throw bricks at the Education Ministry building as police respond with tear gas and water cannon.

item.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
item.description: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

item.title: Houthi missile hits Aramco building after Saudi-led coalition hits Yemen fuel depot
item.description: The Saudi energy ministry says the Houthi attack caused a "limited fire" at Aramco's headquarters complex in Dhahran.

item.title: Watch: Block of flats destroyed in Russian strikes on Ukraine
item.description: BBC Ukraine Correspondent Dan Johnson is in Kyiv, where at least three people were killed in overnight strikes.
